strings.en: Okay, let's make this quick!
There, there! Gotcha!
Sorry, but you're mine!
Bad spot to be in, huh? Take that!
Keep the change! Go!
Too bad. I can see you plain as day.
Hiii. How about this?
It's just a little something... here you go!
Are you... me?
What's going on? What... are you to me?
Keep the change! Go!
A girl should always return a favor. Here!
Payback hurts, you know...!
Well, well, my turn!
Look, look, you're in range!
There won't be a second time, you know?
You have to accept my thanks!
...Will this take you down? Want to bet?
Oh dear... Well, I lasted a while...
Ah, Kyosukeee! ...Not that he'd ever play along.
Whoa whoa, this is pretty bad-bad!
Direct hit! It still moves, right...!?
Hey! Aren't you cheating somehow!?
Whoa, hey! Time out, time out!
Gentler, gentler!
Yikes! It still moves, but... geez!
Wow, that's a pretty bold attack, isn't it?
Ow ow! This one really stings.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a... oh, ow, owww!
It hit!? Weiss has thin armor, so go easy!
Wow! Not bad, huh?
Ow! That attack packs a punch.
That won't cut it.
Every little bit adds up, they say. But I'm still fine.
Wow, that surprised me!
Treat a maiden's soft skin with more care.
Hey! Geez, where are your manners?
Wow! Well, things don't always go right.
So shaky, so shaky! Geez!
That won't cut it.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee... something like that?
That's not gonna hit. Bye-bye!
Move early and that's easy enough.
Okay, on to the next one!
You don't know how fast Weiss is, do you?
Too easy!
Hup... Well, that's about right.
Wow! If you want to shoot me down, you'll have to try harder.
Whoa, so bright! That's why I hate barriers.
Tight and right, total defense! Not bad, huh?
Geez, what is this!
Did I get carried away and fire too much? Oh dear...
What a nasty attack, honestly!
Okay, have some of this too!
Okay, okay! Covering you!
Wow! Nice position, huh?
Look out!
I'm pretty devoted, aren't I?
Oops, not on my watch!
Come closer and I'll cut you! ...Or something like that.
I don't really like close combat!
This one doesn't reach very far.
It doesn't reach far, but it's powerful!
Oxtongue Launcher, B mode! Enjoy!
Oxtongue Launcher... E mode. Here goes!
Oxtongue means 'spear.' Educational, huh?
I'll finish it with the Oxtongue Launcher!
Howling Launcher... E mode. Here goes!
Awooo! And now, Howling Launcher, let's give it a go!
It handles just like the Oxtongue Launcher.
Let's see, B mode... Sorry to keep you waiting!
It doesn't reach far, but it's powerful!
Let's settle this with my Howly Launcher!
My special treat! Treat yourself... just kidding!
The moment you've waited for! Kinda phony-looking weapon, though!
Special bonus! Goooo!
I wonder how this thing even works?
Excellen, we're moving in.
Huh? Oh!! Our Love-Love Attack!
Match my timing. Let's go.
Aww, Kyosukeee! Geez!
We end this in one go!
Ready, Kyosuke?
Yeah, I'll match you.
Then with the power of our love...!
...Let's go!!
Hey! Weren't you gonna match me!?
